leaf_cases.note: 历史复用：Paperclip 首页旧快照（sha256 57a74c8d…）只把 Media Kit Builder 列为免费工具，正文仅一句入口描述，没有模板/内容模型/成品分发流程；其产品定位本身是品牌交易跟踪（赞助管理），维持不建立关系，候选与缺口保留。本轮补采：Pixsprint 官方首页与产品页正文显示其为创作者/摄影师的媒体资料包构建器，涵盖作品汇集、手填或 Instagram 受众数据、页面编排、公开或密码保护分享、套餐与联系方式，以及浏览/点击分析；官方示例链接打开真实托管的 kit 成品（含受众指标、套餐、联系入口与分享按钮），故新增商业条目 commercial:pixsprint。另核对两个 MIT 开源候选：Reckless98/creatordeck 的 share 路由只是本机屏幕演示（presentation share mode），不产出可分发链接或文件；yuekelele/creatortools 为 v0.1 原型，成品中 services、rates、audience、contact 为硬编码占位，仅姓名、简介与粉丝数可编辑，未形成完整商业推介内容模型；二者均未建立关系。未把检索无结果断言为不存在。
leaf_cases.service_boundary: 只记录与叶子定义核心匹配的完整应用或完整业务子模块；工具入口、导航或单句营销文案不作为核心工作流证据。开源候选须为完整应用服务并具备完整许可证；桌面/CLI 生成器、原型或仅本机演示分享不计入。商业仅记录名称、官网、简短用途、基本类型关系及官方来源。

fetch_outcomes: reused historical snapshot: https://papercliphq.com/ (sha256 57a74c8de66fdaa552fc1b1d13e72f8e166187f7738bf869608aff0916be4bfc); title is brand deal tracker and only a one-line Media Kit Builder tool entry, no workflow body

fetched official homepage: https://pixsprint.app/ (sha256 e61c1e54ef26de92169980678ccb18584c7341e908e60b2ec09ef265f3c122bb); states creators put work, audience stats and collaboration offers into one polished media kit link with view/click tracking and example kits

fetched official product page: https://pixsprint.app/product (sha256 7384be527074a0059929d7249036de2800b2d33591652fa17e9509b1e0a509d7); five documented surfaces cover asset gathering, manual/Instagram stats, kit curation, public/private sharing, and brand-interest review

fetched an official hosted example kit: https://studio.pixsprint.app/rafalbagrowski/gallery/freedom-redefined-the-open-road (sha256 24eb44b9e7f525d80bdea3a815a64c31b418996695ab9b0e8c5bfb1830109bcf); page renders audience/engagement metrics, service tiers, contact actions and a share control

inspected candidate repository Reckless98/creatordeck (MIT, github id 1203642566) README and components/kits/share-stage.tsx via GitHub API/raw; builder and templates exist but share mode is a screen-presentation view driven by local state, not a shareable link or downloadable artifact

inspected candidate repository yuekelele/creatortools (MIT, github id 583122094) README, MediaKitTool.js and MinimalistKit.js via GitHub API/raw; form edits name/subheader/bio/follower counts and exports JPEG, while services, rates, demographics and contact are hardcoded placeholders, so the pitch content model is incomplete
inspected Tsukumogami-Software/milou (MIT): static press-kit CLI generator, no hosted builder workflow; not treated as a complete web application service
no qualifying open-source web application service with a complete license and distributable artifact was established in this round
